page.overview:
Who is Sing?

this moment monster.|Sing to Goro in Mortal Kombat Blood and Thunder #3}}

Sing is a fictional character of the Malibu Comics. He fuses with his twin brother Sang to create Siang, the greatest warrior of the Order of Light. He makes his first appearance as Sing in Mortal Kombat Blood and Thunder #1.

It is said in the comic book that individually Sing and Sang possess such exceptional skill and strength, but with their ability to merge into a single body, their abilities double.
